review_evidence: README describes kernel-checkable primality proofs using Pocklington and a cube-root variant, with generated certificates only as an auxiliary convenience.
Fifteen of 30 Lean files contain proposition declarations, including Pocklington correctness, modular exponentiation lemmas and explicit primality/certificate examples.
The metaprogramming is backed by substantive theorem-level primality verification, so source retirement or hard exclusion would lose formal prior art.
summary: Reviewed PrimeCert; retain the verified Pocklington primality machinery and certificate theorems.
